title: Hosea Chapter 2 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Hosea chapter 2 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Hosea Chapter 2 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Hosea Chapter 2.

questions.question: What names are the brethren and sisters told to say according to Hosea 2:1?
questions.correctAnswer: Ammi and Ruhamah
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:1 commands to say unto the brethren Ammi and to the sisters Ruhamah.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:2, what is the relationship status between God and the woman?
options: She is not my wife, neither am I her husband
She is my wife and I am her husband
questions.correctAnswer: She is not my wife, neither am I her husband
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:2 clearly states that she is not God's wife and He is not her husband.

questions.question: What will happen if she does not put away her whoredoms and adulteries according to Hosea 2:3?
options: She will be stripped naked and made as a wilderness
She will be blessed with many children
questions.correctAnswer: She will be stripped naked and made as a wilderness
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:3 warns that she will be stripped naked and set as in the day she was born, like a wilderness and dry land.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:4 says God will have mercy upon her children.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:4 states that God will not have mercy upon her children because they are children of whoredoms.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:5, what did the mother say she would do?
options: Go after her lovers who give her bread, water, wool, flax, oil, and drink
Build a house for her children
Go to the temple to pray
questions.correctAnswer: Go after her lovers who give her bread, water, wool, flax, oil, and drink
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:5 quotes the mother saying she will go after her lovers who supply her needs.

questions.question: What will God do to hedge up her way according to Hosea 2:6?
options: Hedge her way with thorns and make a wall
questions.correctAnswer: Hedge her way with thorns and make a wall
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:6 states God will hedge her way with thorns and make a wall so she cannot find her paths.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:7, what will she say after she fails to find her lovers?
options: I will go and return to my first husband
I will build a new city
questions.correctAnswer: I will go and return to my first husband
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:7 explains that after not overtaking or finding her lovers, she will say she will return to her first husband.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:8 says she knew that God gave her corn, wine, oil, silver, and gold.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:8 says she did not know that God gave her these things.

questions.question: What does God say He will take away in Hosea 2:9?
questions.correctAnswer: Corn, wine, wool, and flax
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:9 states God will take away corn, wine, wool, and flax given to her.

questions.question: What will God do to her mirth and feast days according to Hosea 2:11?
options: Cause all her mirth to cease
questions.correctAnswer: Cause all her mirth to cease
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:11 says God will cause all her mirth, feast days, new moons, sabbaths, and solemn feasts to cease.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:12, what will happen to her vines and fig trees?
options: Destroyed and made a forest for beasts to eat
Given as gifts to her lovers
questions.correctAnswer: Destroyed and made a forest for beasts to eat
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:12 declares God will destroy her vines and fig trees and make them a forest for beasts.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:13 mentions that she forgot the LORD while going after her lovers.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:13 says she went after her lovers and forgot the LORD.

questions.question: What will God do to allure her according to Hosea 2:14?
options: Bring her into the wilderness and speak comfortably unto her
questions.correctAnswer: Bring her into the wilderness and speak comfortably unto her
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:14 states God will allure her and bring her into the wilderness to comfort her.

questions.question: In Hosea 2, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah
I will hedge up thy way with thorns
I will take away the names of Baalim
I will destroy her vines and her fig trees
questions.correctAnswer: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:1 is the first instruction given in the chapter, before others like hedging the way or destroying vines.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:16 says that the woman will call God Baali.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:16 says she shall call God Ishi and no more Baali.

medium.title: Hosea Chapter 2 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Hosea Chapter 2 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:9, what will the LORD take away as a consequence of Israel's unfaithfulness?
options: His corn, wine, wool, and flax
questions.correctAnswer: His corn, wine, wool, and flax
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:9 states that the LORD will take away His corn, wine, wool, and flax which were given to cover her nakedness, indicating a withdrawal of blessings due to Israel's unfaithfulness. This connects to the removal of prosperity mentioned in verses 8 and 10, showing consequences of idolatry.

questions.question: Hosea 2:10 says the LORD will reveal Israel's lewdness in the sight of whom?
questions.correctAnswer: Her lovers
questions.explanation: Verse 10 explains that the LORD will expose Israel's unfaithfulness ('lewdness') before her lovers, symbolizing false gods or idols, and none shall rescue her from His hand. This follows from the removal of blessings in verse 9 and leads to discipline.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:11 say will cease as part of God's judgment on Israel?
options: Mirth, feast days, new moons, sabbaths, and solemn feasts
questions.correctAnswer: Mirth, feast days, new moons, sabbaths, and solemn feasts
questions.explanation: Verse 11 details that all joy and religious celebrations, including feast days and sabbaths, will cease as a consequence of Israel's sinfulness. This links with the exposure of unfaithfulness in verse 10 and destruction of blessings in verse 12.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:12 describe the fate of Israel's vineyards and fig trees?
options: They will be destroyed and become a forest for beasts
They will be given to the priests
They will be used for temple offerings
questions.correctAnswer: They will be destroyed and become a forest for beasts
questions.explanation: Verse 12 states that the vineyards and fig trees, which Israel claimed as rewards from her lovers, will be destroyed and turned into a forest where wild beasts will feed. This shows God's judgment on idolatry and false trust, linking back to verses 10 and 11.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:13 say about Israel's actions during the days of Baalim?
options: She burned incense, adorned herself with jewels, followed her lovers, and forgot the LORD
She built altars to the true God
She gathered in unity for worship
questions.correctAnswer: She burned incense, adorned herself with jewels, followed her lovers, and forgot the LORD
questions.explanation: Verse 13 reveals Israel's idolatry during the Baalim festivals where she burned incense and decked herself out to follow her lovers, symbolizing false gods, and in so doing, she forgot the LORD. This explains the context for the judgment described in previous verses.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:14, what will God do after judging Israel?
options: Allure her, bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her
Ignore her and turn to another nation
questions.correctAnswer: Allure her, bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her
questions.explanation: Verse 14 shows God's loving plan after judgment: He will allure Israel, bring her into the wilderness, and comfort her. This demonstrates God's intent to restore and reconcile, following the discipline described in verses 9-13.

questions.question: What symbolic gift will God give Israel according to Hosea 2:15?
options: Her vineyards and the valley of Achor as a door of hope
questions.correctAnswer: Her vineyards and the valley of Achor as a door of hope
questions.explanation: Verse 15 explains that God will restore Israel's vineyards and give her the valley of Achor, symbolizing a door of hope. This signifies restoration and joy similar to the days of youth and deliverance from Egypt, linking back to the comfort promised in verse 14.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:16 describe the change in Israel's relationship with God?
options: She will call Him Ishi, not Baali
She will build altars to Baal
questions.correctAnswer: She will call Him Ishi, not Baali
questions.explanation: Verse 16 indicates a transformation where Israel will call God 'Ishi' (My husband) instead of 'Baali' (My lord/owner), symbolizing a restored intimate and faithful relationship, contrasting her previous idolatry mentioned in verse 13.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:17 promise about the names of Baalim?
options: They will be taken away and no longer remembered
They will be inscribed in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: They will be taken away and no longer remembered
questions.explanation: Verse 17 promises that God will remove the names of Baalim from Israel's mouth, and they will no longer be remembered, showing the complete rejection of false gods and restoration of exclusive worship of the LORD.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:18, what will God do to bring peace on the earth?
options: Make a covenant with animals and break weapons of war
Send a mighty army to fight
Cause natural disasters to cleanse the land
questions.correctAnswer: Make a covenant with animals and break weapons of war
questions.explanation: Verse 18 describes a future peace where God makes a covenant with beasts, birds, and creeping things, and breaks the bow, sword, and war from the earth, symbolizing universal peace and security after restoration.

questions.question: Hosea 2:19 emphasizes God's commitment to Israel by saying He will betroth them in what qualities?
questions.correctAnswer: Righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, and mercies
questions.explanation: Verse 19 states that God's betrothal to Israel will be based on righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, and mercies, highlighting a covenant grounded in moral and loving qualities rather than mere external blessings.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:20 say about the result of God's betrothal to Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Israel will know the LORD
questions.explanation: Verse 20 promises that through God's faithfulness in betrothing Israel, they will come to truly know the LORD, indicating restored relationship and understanding, contrasting previous forgetfulness in verse 13.

questions.question: Based on Hosea 2:14-15, what does God's act of bringing Israel into the wilderness teach us about His approach to restoration?
options: He leads His people through trials with comfort and hope
He abandons His people in desolation
He rewards only with material wealth
questions.correctAnswer: He leads His people through trials with comfort and hope
questions.explanation: Verses 14 and 15 describe God alluring Israel into the wilderness to speak comfortably and give her vineyards and a door of hope, teaching that God's restoration involves guiding through hardship with loving comfort and offering renewed hope.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:16-17 teach us about the power of names in spiritual relationship?
options: Changing the name from Baali to Ishi symbolizes restored intimacy with God
Calling God by many names is encouraged
questions.correctAnswer: Changing the name from Baali to Ishi symbolizes restored intimacy with God
questions.explanation: Verses 16 and 17 show that calling God 'Ishi' instead of 'Baali' reflects a new intimate relationship, and the removal of Baalim's names signifies rejecting false gods, teaching the importance of language reflecting spiritual fidelity.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:11 states that God will cause Israel's religious celebrations to continue as usual despite her unfaithfulness.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:11 explicitly says God will cause all her mirth, feast days, new moons, sabbaths, and solemn feasts to cease, indicating that religious celebrations will not continue as usual but will be stopped as part of discipline.

hard.title: Hosea Chapter 2 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Hosea Chapter 2.

questions.question: What will God do with the names of Baalim according to Hosea 2?
options: He will preserve them for future generations
He will take them away and they shall no longer be remembered
He will change them to new names
He will honor them as gods
questions.correctAnswer: He will take them away and they shall no longer be remembered
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:17 states that God will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name, indicating a complete removal of Baal worship references.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2, what covenant will God make on that day?
options: A covenant with the kings of the earth
A covenant for them with the beasts, fowls, and creeping things
A covenant with the sea and the stars
questions.correctAnswer: A covenant for them with the beasts, fowls, and creeping things
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:18 reveals that God will make a covenant with the animals of the earth, symbolizing peace and restoration in creation, paralleling the covenant with Noah in Genesis 9:9-11.

questions.question: Which weapons will God break and remove from the earth as described in Hosea 2?
options: The bow, the spear, and the shield
The bow, the sword, and the battle
The sword, the axe, and the spear
The spear, the sword, and the chariot
questions.correctAnswer: The bow, the sword, and the battle
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:18 states God will break the bow, the sword, and the battle, symbolizing the end of war and violence, similar in theme to Isaiah 2:4 where weapons are turned into tools for peace.

questions.question: What four qualities does God say He will betroth Israel to Him in Hosea 2:19?
questions.correctAnswer: Righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, and mercies
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:19 explicitly lists these four qualities as the basis of the covenant marriage relationship, highlighting God’s comprehensive commitment to Israel.

questions.question: What new name will Israel call the LORD in Hosea 2:16?
questions.correctAnswer: Ishi
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:16 says Israel will call the LORD 'Ishi' (meaning 'my husband'), indicating a restored intimate relationship that contrasts with the previous name 'Baali' (my master).

questions.question: What will happen to Israel’s vineyards and the valley of Achor according to Hosea 2?
options: They will be given her from the wilderness as a door of hope
They will be sold to foreign nations
They will become a place of exile
questions.correctAnswer: They will be given her from the wilderness as a door of hope
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:15 promises restoration by giving Israel her vineyards and the valley of Achor, symbolizing transformation from trouble to hope, echoing themes from Joshua 7:24-26.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:20 says God will betroth Israel to Him in faithfulness and they will know the LORD.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:20 clearly states that God will betroth Israel in faithfulness and that they shall know the LORD, signifying restored relationship and knowledge of God.

questions.question: What does God say He will hear in the day described in Hosea 2:21?
options: The heavens, which shall hear the earth
questions.correctAnswer: The heavens, which shall hear the earth
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:21 states that God will hear, and the heavens shall hear the earth, using cosmic imagery to illustrate universal harmony, a theme also seen in Psalm 19:1.

questions.question: Which agricultural products are mentioned in Hosea 2:22 as hearing Jezreel?
questions.correctAnswer: Corn, wine, and oil
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:22 lists corn, wine, and oil as hearing Jezreel, symbolizing prosperity and blessing, connecting with the agricultural abundance promised in Deuteronomy 28.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:23 describe God's mercy toward those who had not obtained mercy?
options: God will have mercy upon them and call them His people
They will be given a second chance only after many years
questions.correctAnswer: God will have mercy upon them and call them His people
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:23 states God will have mercy on those not previously shown mercy and call those not His people 'my people,' indicating restoration and inclusion, echoing the theme in Romans 9:25-26.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Hosea 2:19-20 where God betroths Israel to Himself 'for ever' and in 'righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, mercies, and faithfulness'?
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasm
questions.explanation: The passage uses chiasm by framing the betrothal with contrasting and parallel qualities, emphasizing the comprehensive nature of God's covenant love, a common Hebrew poetic structure.

questions.question: What is the significance of the name 'Ishi' given to the LORD in Hosea 2:16 in the original Hebrew context?
options: It means 'my judge' emphasizing God's justice
It means 'my husband' emphasizing intimate covenant relationship
It means 'my creator' emphasizing God's power
questions.correctAnswer: It means 'my husband' emphasizing intimate covenant relationship
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'Ishi' means 'my husband,' illustrating God's intimate, covenantal relationship with Israel, contrasting with 'Baali' meaning 'my master' or 'owner' (Hosea 2:16).

questions.question: Which other biblical passage closely connects with Hosea 2:18’s theme of peace and breaking of weapons?
questions.correctAnswer: Isaiah 2:4
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:4 similarly prophesies the beating of swords into plowshares and the end of war, echoing Hosea 2:18’s vision of peace and safety.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:23 fulfill an earlier promise found in the Old Testament?
options: It fulfills the promise of Abraham’s seed blessing all nations
It echoes the promise of Jeremiah 31:33 about a new covenant
It fulfills the promise of inclusion of Gentiles as God’s people
It repeats the Mosaic law about the covenant
questions.correctAnswer: It fulfills the promise of inclusion of Gentiles as God’s people
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:23’s declaration that those who were not God’s people will be called His people fulfills the prophetic inclusion of Gentiles, also seen in Isaiah 56:6-7 and Romans 9:25.

questions.question: True or False: Hosea 2:17-23 describes a future restoration where idolatry is completely removed and a new covenant relationship is established.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: These verses detail God’s removal of Baal names, establishment of covenant, peace, and mercy, indicating a full restoration and rejection of idolatry.

theological.title: Hosea Chapter 2 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Hosea Chapter 2 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What new names does God instruct to be given to the brethren and sisters, symbolizing restoration and mercy?
questions.correctAnswer: Ammi and Ruhamah
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:1 commands to call the brethren 'Ammi' and the sisters 'Ruhamah', symbolizing 'my people' and 'having obtained mercy', respectively.

questions.question: According to Hosea 2:2, why does God say He is not the husband of the woman?
options: Because she has committed whoredoms and adulteries
questions.correctAnswer: Because she has committed whoredoms and adulteries
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:2 states that the woman is not God's wife due to her acts of whoredom and adultery, indicating unfaithfulness in their covenant relationship.

questions.question: What consequences does God declare will come upon the woman if she continues in her unfaithfulness, as described in Hosea 2:3?
options: She will be stripped naked and become like a wilderness
She will be exalted above others
She will be given abundant blessings
She will be hidden from her lovers
questions.correctAnswer: She will be stripped naked and become like a wilderness
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:3 warns that the woman will be stripped as she was born, made into a wilderness and dry land, and slain with thirst due to her unfaithfulness.

questions.question: What doctrine about the consequences of sin upon offspring is expressed in Hosea 2:4?
options: God will not have mercy on children born of whoredoms
Children are always innocent and blessed
Sin has no effect on descendants
questions.correctAnswer: God will not have mercy on children born of whoredoms
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:4 declares that God will not show mercy on the children because they are children of whoredoms, indicating the doctrine of the consequences of sin extending to descendants.

questions.question: What is the significance of the 'hedge of thorns' and 'wall' mentioned in Hosea 2:6?
options: God blocks her path to her lovers as a form of judgment
God welcomes her with open arms
God provides a safe path for her journey
questions.correctAnswer: God blocks her path to her lovers as a form of judgment
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:6 describes God hedging up her way with thorns and making a wall so she cannot find her paths, symbolizing divine judgment and restriction from sin.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:7 reflect on the theme of repentance and returning to God?
options: She will seek her lovers but fail, then decide to return to her first husband
She will find her lovers and forget God
She will remain in sin without regret
questions.correctAnswer: She will seek her lovers but fail, then decide to return to her first husband
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:7 shows the woman chasing after her lovers but not finding them, leading her to desire returning to her first husband, symbolizing repentance and restoration with God.

questions.question: What attribute of God is demonstrated in Hosea 2:8 where God gave corn, wine, oil, silver, and gold?
questions.correctAnswer: God's providence and benevolence
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:8 reveals God's providence and benevolence by providing physical blessings that were misused by the woman for idol worship.

questions.question: What does God promise to do in Hosea 2:14 that reveals His redemptive and restorative nature?
options: Allure her, bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably to her
questions.correctAnswer: Allure her, bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably to her
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:14 demonstrates God's redemptive love by promising to allure the woman, bring her into the wilderness, and speak kindly to her to restore their relationship.

questions.question: How do verses Hosea 2:19-20 together describe the covenant relationship God promises to establish?
options: An eternal betrothal characterized by righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, mercies, and faithfulness
A temporary agreement based on fear
A conditional covenant dependent on human works
questions.correctAnswer: An eternal betrothal characterized by righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, mercies, and faithfulness
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:19-20 depict a solemn, eternal betrothal between God and His people with qualities of righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, mercies, and faithfulness, illustrating the covenant of grace.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Hosea 2:11 and Hosea 2:12 convey about God's judgment on idolatrous worship?
options: God will cease all their mirth and destroy their vineyards and fig trees associated with idols
God will bless their feasts and vineyards
God replaces their feasts with new celebrations
questions.correctAnswer: God will cease all their mirth and destroy their vineyards and fig trees associated with idols
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:11-12 together show God's judgment by stopping all joy and destroying physical symbols linked to idolatrous worship, demonstrating His intolerance for false worship.

questions.question: How does Hosea 2:16 reveal a transformation in the people's relationship with God?
options: They will call God 'Ishi' (my husband) instead of 'Baali' (my lord)
They will worship Baal with more fervor
questions.correctAnswer: They will call God 'Ishi' (my husband) instead of 'Baali' (my lord)
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:16 portrays a spiritual renewal where the people intimately call God 'Ishi', signifying a close, covenantal relationship rather than a distant lordship as 'Baali'.

questions.question: What does Hosea 2:18 teach about God's future peace and harmony in creation?
options: God will make a covenant with animals and end war, allowing peaceful coexistence
God will cause animals to attack humans
God will ignore the natural world
God will punish creation for sin
questions.correctAnswer: God will make a covenant with animals and end war, allowing peaceful coexistence
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:18 reveals God's sovereignty and peace by promising a covenant with beasts and ending the bow, sword, and battle, indicating universal peace in the eschaton.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth about divine mercy is highlighted by the promise in Hosea 2:23?
options: God will have mercy on those previously without mercy and declare non-people as His people
Mercy is limited to the original covenant people only
God's mercy is conditional on sacrifices
questions.correctAnswer: God will have mercy on those previously without mercy and declare non-people as His people
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:23 teaches the doctrine of sovereign mercy where God extends compassion to the undeserving, transforming outsiders into His covenant people.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that God’s judgment in Hosea 2 demonstrates a harsh, unforgiving deity. What does Hosea 2:14-15 actually teach about God’s nature?
options: God is loving and restorative, alluring His people and giving them a door of hope
God is indifferent to human repentance
God delights in eternal punishment without mercy
God abandons His covenant people permanently
questions.correctAnswer: God is loving and restorative, alluring His people and giving them a door of hope
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:14-15 shows God's compassionate nature by alluring His people, speaking kindly, and providing hope, refuting claims that God is harsh and unforgiving.

questions.question: What theological insight about sin and restoration can be drawn from the combination of Hosea 2:5 and Hosea 2:9?
options: Sin leads to loss of blessings, but God promises to recover what was given to cover nakedness
Sin has no consequences and blessings remain
questions.correctAnswer: Sin leads to loss of blessings, but God promises to recover what was given to cover nakedness
questions.explanation: Hosea 2:5 depicts sin as chasing after false lovers, while 2:9 shows God taking back blessings due to sin but implying restoration is possible through repentance.
